tool_args.rationale: The observations vary both input and sink gradient, but five rows leave genuine ambiguity among the archived siphon branches and four-parameter sink-inhibition models. The open-branch probe can distinguish these before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon with square-root or linear-leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five pilot observations do not reliably distinguish the open branch from other sink-dependent mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit cooperative Hill inhibition or barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Each has four fitted parameters, leaving little evidence for mechanism identification from five rows.
The pilot signatures and archive favor a static sink-dependent mechanism over a coupled trajectory model; the branch probe is cheaper and more targeted.
It does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
